name: artifact-runtime-canvas-bundle-targets-preserved
description: Preserves canvas DOM targets when one script references the canvas IDs and another script in the same page bundle owns the getContext() helper.

source_reference.notes: Regression coverage for corpus canvas targets such as #hero-canvas, #cta-canvas, #hero-sim, and #board.

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime dependency parity is an upstream artifact compiler contract with no legacy comparison.

files.content: <main><canvas id="hero-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><canvas id="cta-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><canvas id="hero-sim" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><canvas id="board" tabindex="0" aria-label="Board"></canvas><script src="main.js"></script><script src="engine.js"></script></main>

Engine.flow(document.getElementById('hero-canvas')); Engine.ambient(document.getElementById('cta-canvas')); const sim = document.getElementById('hero-sim'); new Engine.Renderer(sim); const board = document.getElementById('board'); createBoard(board);

window.Engine = { flow(canvas) { const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 10, 10); }, ambient(canvas) { const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 10, 10); }, Renderer: function (canvas) { this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); } }; function createBoard(canvas) { const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, 10, 10); }
